description: Ask the official GA4 Data API which dimensions and metrics are compatible with a proposed Core report selection.

compatibilityFilter.description: Limit compatibility results to the requested GA4 compatibility category.

dimensions.description: Native reporting dimensions. Validate compatibility with the selected metrics.

metrics.description: Native or documented calculated metric names to request. Check compatibility with the selected dimensions.

propertyId.description: Numeric GA4 property ID or properties/{id}.

name: ga4_check_compatibility

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

title: ga4 check compatibility
